name: Emmaus
notes: Luke places Emmaus sixty stadia, about 11 km (7 miles), from Jerusalem; some ancient manuscripts say one hundred sixty. Several sites have been proposed, and none is certain, so each candidate is shown on the map.

candidates.label: Emmaus Nicopolis (Imwas, near Latrun)
candidates.note: About 30 km from Jerusalem, matching the manuscripts that say 160 stadia. Eusebius and Jerome identified Emmaus here.

candidates.label: El-Qubeibeh
candidates.note: About 11 km from Jerusalem, matching 60 stadia. Honored as Emmaus since the Crusader period, with a Franciscan church today.

candidates.label: Abu Ghosh
candidates.note: About 13 km from Jerusalem. Crusaders also identified Emmaus here.

candidates.label: Motza (Roman Colonia)
candidates.note: Close to Jerusalem. Josephus mentions an Emmaus near the city where Vespasian settled veterans, often identified with this site.
